source: FDD 14.1 and 14.2, LLD 9.5 and 9.5.1. DRAFT: every value is owned by the style specialist (FOI-2, FOI-8, FOI-9). Values marked 'assumed' in the notes are not in the documents and need the specialist's confirmation.

thresholds.dark_lightness_note: assumed: FDD R1 Party says 'dark or statement tops' without a number. 'Statement' = bold (chroma above bold_chroma_above).

cool_seasons_note: assumed: FDD R5 says 'cool seasons' without listing them.

Summer.note: FDD R2: no coats or heavy knits. Which sub-types are heavy knits is assumed: Sweater and Cardigan.

Casual.note: FDD R1: any tops and bottoms except formal shoes with shorts. Sports shorts counted as shorts (assumed).

Work.note: FDD R1: shirt or polo, chinos or trousers, closed shoes (Sandals are open). Layer is not constrained.

Formal.note: FDD R1: shirt, tailored trousers, formal shoes, blazer if available. Suit and Tuxedo (one item in layer and bottom) are allowed because they hold the blazer and trousers (assumed). The layer is optional.

Party.note: FDD R1: dark or statement tops, jeans or trousers, clean sneakers or boots. 'Clean' is not checked.

Sport.note: FDD R1: activewear for the top and bottom, sneakers for footwear. Layer is not constrained.
